newsitem.title: JAPAN: Isuzu Construction says to liquidate.
newsitem.headline: Isuzu Construction says to liquidate.

text.p: Isuzu Construction Co Ltd said on Friday that it plans to go into liquidation.
Isuzu Construction said in a statement that its debts totalled 59.1 billion yen. The company said it would formally decide on liquidation at a board meeting to be held on March 15.
It did not say when the company was likely to be liquidated.
The Osaka Securities Exchange announced separately that Isuzu would be delisted from the exchange on March 18.
The company's business suffered from land price falls due to the bursting of the so-called bubble economy of inflated land and share prices in the early 1990s, the company said.
It was trying to restructure but falling demand due to uncertainty over the Japanese economy and intensifying competition squeezed its business, the company said.
Isuzu Construction shares closed down 10 yen at 190 on Friday.
